productGoal:
Wheatley Linux — a personal, non-commercial Arch/Artix-based Linux distribution.
Build a NEW, friendly installer (keep the existing working ISO build: Docker + artools, build.sh, and the custom packages apeturewm / nvwm / branding).

The installer lets the user COMPOSE their system with clear choices, and for every
window manager / desktop it must show: ease-of-use rating, how lightweight it is,
and default keybindings — with a screenshot preview if at all possible.

CORE:
- dinit is the RECOMMENDED init system (label it "recommended" in the installer).
- New terminals auto-run fastfetch on open (ship shell rc that runs fastfetch).

KERNEL:
- Primary kernel = CachyOS kernel (current default).
- Zen kernel offered as a SECONDARY option.

SUPPORT (checkboxes):
- Bluetooth: an opt-in checkbox that installs Bluetooth support (bluez + service)
  plus a Bluetooth GUI app (e.g. Blueman / Overskride).

GAMING (all optional):
- Optional "Gaming Mode" that fully prepares the system to be plug-and-play for gaming.
- Preinstalled gaming apps: Steam, Heroic Games Launcher, Proton-GE, Vulkan +
  precompiled/enabled Vulkan shaders, gamemode/mangohud, etc.
- Auto-detect and install GPU drivers.

MINIMAL INSTALL:
- Optional minimal install path (no WM/DE preselected, bare system).

WINDOW MANAGERS (multi-select — the user can install several and pick which one to
use at the LOGIN SCREEN; the installer must clearly tell users they can have
multiple at once and choose per login):
- apeturewm — Aperture-themed (custom package, exists).
- nvwm — light and strong (custom project, exists).
- Mangowc — user-friendly. Let the user CHOOSE the bar/shell for it:
    (a) Noctalia shell, or
    (b) the Quickshell (QS) config by ilyamiro — "imperative-dots"
        (github.com/ilyamiro/imperative-dots; local ref ~/src/nixos-configuration,
        running QS at ~/.config/hypr/scripts/quickshell) — the shell that runs on
        this machine's Mangowc right now. Its v2.0.0 is explicitly a portable
        quickshell config on top of any Wayland compositor (Niri, MangoWM, etc.).
- Niri — user-friendly. Same bar/shell CHOICE as Mangowc: (a) Noctalia shell, or
    (b) ilyamiro Quickshell (QS) config.
- Sway — minimal Wayland.
  NOTE: for the QS option, ilyamiro's previews/*.png can be reused as the installer
  screenshot preview. Both bar/shell choices must show ease/lightness/keybinds.

DESKTOP ENVIRONMENTS ("de slop" section — the maintainer dislikes DEs; include only
for friendliness, optional, clearly separated/labeled):
- KDE Plasma.
- XFCE.

Palette: amber — #100A02 / #A66900 / #F1B00A. Keep it personal/non-commercial.
name: Wheatley Linux
